$comment: Fixture — the publication history is a string instead of an array, the shape a hand-edit of a one-element array produces. Must refuse: the already-published check reads this field, and a non-array one is unknown history, not empty history. Measured before the guard existed: this exact file authorized 0.1.0 while `published: ["0.1.0"]` refused it, the two differing only in that type.
